        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "from sklearn.datasets import load_breast_cancer\n",
        "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split\n",
        "from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier\n",
        "from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import (\n",
        "    accuracy_score,\n",
        "    classification_report,\n",
        "    ConfusionMatrixDisplay\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# 1. Load dataset\n",
        "data = load_breast_cancer()\n",
        "X = pd.DataFrame(data.data, columns=data.feature_names)\n",
        "y = data.target\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Dataset Shape:\", X.shape)\n",
        "print(\"\\nFirst 5 Rows:\")\n",
        "print(X.head())\n",
        "\n",
        "# 2. Split dataset into training and testing\n",
        "X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(\n",
        "    X, y, test_size=0.20, random_state=42, stratify=y\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# 3. Train Decision Tree model\n",
        "dt = DecisionTreeClassifier(random_state=42, max_depth=4)\n",
        "dt.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
        "dt_pred = dt.predict(X_test)\n",
        "\n",
        "# 4. Train Random Forest model\n",
        "rf = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=42)\n",
        "rf.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
        "rf_pred = rf.predict(X_test)\n",
        "\n",
        "# 5. Display model accuracy\n",
        "print(\"\\nDecision Tree Accuracy:\",\n",
        "      round(accuracy_score(y_test, dt_pred) * 100, 2), \"%\")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Random Forest Accuracy:\",\n",
        "      round(accuracy_score(y_test, rf_pred) * 100, 2), \"%\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# 6. Classification report\n",
        "print(\"\\nRandom Forest Classification Report:\")\n",
        "print(classification_report(\n",
        "    y_test, rf_pred, target_names=data.target_names\n",
        "))\n",
        "\n",
        "# 7. Confusion matrix\n",
        "ConfusionMatrixDisplay.from_predictions(\n",
        "    y_test, rf_pred, display_labels=data.target_names,\n",
        "    cmap=\"Blues\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Random Forest Confusion Matrix\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# 8. Compare model accuracy\n",
        "models = [\"Decision Tree\", \"Random Forest\"]\n",
        "accuracies = [\n",
        "    accuracy_score(y_test, dt_pred) * 100,\n",
        "    accuracy_score(y_test, rf_pred) * 100\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.bar(models, accuracies)\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Accuracy (%)\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Machine Learning Model Comparison\")\n",
        "plt.ylim(0, 100)\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Predictive modeling completed successfully!\")"
      ]
    }
